properties.name: apilens.capture-logs
properties.description: Ship exceptions the application logs at ERROR (Logback or Log4j2) as apilens.exception logs tied to the request's trace: errors (default) or off.

values.description: Events logged at ERROR with a throwable become apilens.exception logs.
No headers or bodies: method, path, status, latency, sizes and consumer only. Recommended for a first production rollout.
Headers and bodies on, masked by the built-in patterns, bodies capped at 16 KB.
The defaults; same as leaving it unset.
